explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 198 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the fentanyl citrate injection shortage on 2012-01-01 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21.
The shortage lists Hospira, Inc. (NDC 0409-9094-22) and Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. (NDC 0641-6248-10) as affected manufacturers.
Corvale East and Corvale General both stock Hospira-labeled fentanyl citrate (NDC 00409909422) per their item records.
Hospira's registered plant (FEI 1021343) received an OAI classification on 2011-06-17, 198 days before the shortage posting.
The same plant received additional OAI classifications on 2010-01-19 (712 days before posting) and 2011-08-04 (150 days before posting).
A Warning Letter was issued to this plant on 2010-04-12, 629 days before the shortage posting.
Corvale General also stocks Hikma-labeled product (NDC 00641624810) from a plant (FEI 2220525) with only VAI classifications in FDA's record.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: move the primary carboplatin contract from Accord to Teva and keep Accord as secondary. Rationale: Accord's supplier plant had an FDA warning letter; Teva supply steadier (demo history). Approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD.

Q-595a09.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%fentanyl%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%fentanyl%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-8887c7.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('bfa8018a-4cbc-434b-e09e-782872b0340a', 'ce5db1c2-feb1-4ad2-847a-d02e865bd47e') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-298f38.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%fentanyl%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-6d17a4.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%fentanyl%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-00cc4a.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%fentanyl%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-20e41d.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1021343', '2220525', '3001833549', '3008887707') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-86c997.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1021343', '2220525', '3001833549', '3008887707') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-84c665.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1021343', '2220525') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('hospira', 'hikma')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-5013ac.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('hospira', 'hikma') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%fentanyl%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-8cc1cd.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('639034', '732886', '740633') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-284870.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00409909422', '00641602725', '00641624810')
